question: After a month with a sleep app, 70% of users say they sleep better. What is the missing number?
options: How a similar group without it slept
How long the users slept before
answer: How a similar group without the app slept. People install a sleep app in a bad patch, and bad patches mostly pass; the attention alone can help too. Only a comparison group shows how much of the 70% the app itself did, and it may be very little.
move: An improvement needs a twin who got nothing before it counts as an effect.
trap: A before-and-after with nobody who went without.
reference: Holland, Statistics and Causal Inference, Journal of the American Statistical Association, 1986
